月光在她黑纱上流淌成液态的银，每一步都踏碎满地蟾光。
她垂眸时，睫影如蝶翅轻颤；抬袖间，夜雾便顺着墨色绸缎滑落。
衣摆扫过青石，惊起细碎的露珠，每一颗都藏着未竟的叹息。
她立在那儿，像一截被夜色浸透的月光，温柔得让人不敢触碰——生怕一伸手，这团朦胧的夜便散了，只余下满袖的凉。

Moonlight flowed like liquid silver on her black veil, each step shattering the shimmering moonlight on the ground.
When she lowered her eyes, her eyelashes trembled like butterfly wings; with a flick of her sleeve, night mist slid down her dark silk.
The hem of her dress swept across the bluestone, startling tiny dewdrops, each one holding an unfinished sigh.
She stood there, like a section of moonlight soaked in the night, so gentle that one dared not touch her—afraid that with a single touch, this hazy night would dissipate, leaving only the coolness of her sleeves.
